name: Bitcoin's $100k Breakout — Post-Election Rally 2024
description: Bitcoin enters November 2024 around $69k. The US election on November 5 delivers a decisively pro-crypto outcome, and the market rips: Bitcoin runs almost without pause and crosses $100,000 for the first time on December 5, 2024, dragging Solana, Dogecoin, and the rest of the majors up with it. A sustained one-way momentum regime with sharp pullbacks along the way — tests whether a bot can stay with a strong trend and size into strength without getting shaken out, the mirror image of the crash scenarios.
